Messages.Author: PDB6
Messages.Body:
I am fairly certain that all the quotes that were changed on the VTES
versions of Jyhad cards were done so because of possible copyright
violation issues that WOTC chose to ignore in the original set. These
were mostly quotes from songs (Head like a Hole by NIN, Sensual World by
Kate Bush) or popular sources (Vampire Lestat by Anne Rice, The original
WAC text from Firesign Theatre) that were presumably used without
permission.

I always liked the Twin Peaks quote on Owl Companion and the text on the
original WAC: "The car stopped on a dime. Unfortunately, the dime was in
Mr. Rococco's pocket..."

Peter D Bakija
PD...@aol.com

truth!"
